canonical_name: pid-autotune (Hirschmann) -- Astrom-Hagglund relay-feedback autotuner with Ziegler-Nichols / Tyreus-Luyben / Pessen rules, on a simulated brewing kettle
lineage: Astrom & Hagglund's relay auto-tuning (Automatica 1984): put the loop under a relay, measure the induced limit cycle's amplitude and period (ultimate gain and period), then compute PID gains by a tuning rule -- the mechanism inside industrial PID controllers' 'autotune' buttons. This implementation (2016-) drives a first-order thermal kettle model (volume, heater power, ambient loss) and prints the gains each rule yields; used by home-brewing controllers (CraftBeerPi lineage).
version: github.com/hirschmann/pid-autotune master as of 2026-09-13 (commit in hashes)
compiler_or_interpreter: python 3.11 (docker python:3.11-slim; matplotlib only if plotting)
dependencies: none for the autotune path (matplotlib for --plot only)
entry_points: autotune.py PIDAutotune(setpoint, out_step, sampletime, lookback, ...).run(input); get_pid_parameters(rule); sim.py autotune <args>

example.command: python sim.py autotune --volume 40 ... ; python sim.py autotune --volume 10 ...
example.output: different Kp/Ki/Kd per rule for each plant: the CHANGING PLANT -> ADAPTATION -> ALTERED PARAMETERS chain

upstream_docs: Astrom & Hagglund, Automatic tuning of simple regulators with specifications on phase and amplitude margins, Automatica 20(5), 1984

human_capability_summary.built_to: let a controller find its own gains from the plant it is attached to, by provoking a controlled oscillation and measuring it
human_capability_summary.pressure: unknown plant dynamics (kettle size, heater power), a user who cannot hand-tune
human_capability_summary.success_means: the measured limit cycle yields gains that regulate the plant; a different plant yields different gains

human_environmental_pressure: unknown/varying plant, noisy temperature sensor, slow thermal dynamics
human_failure_condition: no limit cycle detected (tuning fails) or gains that oscillate the real plant
behavioral_entry_point: change --volume / --heater-power / --ambient-temp and compare the tuned gains and the limit-cycle period

lineage_relations.note: the PID this tunes; the vault's fixed-gain PID beside a gain-finding mechanism

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run pid-autotune-hirschmann
